topic: Bruno helps an old slow tortoise cross the garden path.

episode.title: Mishi & Bruno: The Slow Little Crossing

shots.narration: Can Bruno help this tiny tortoise cross the whole path?
shots.scene: Sunny garden path, an old wooden wind-up tortoise toy at the grassy edge, visible winding key, vertical 9:16, rounded 3D family animation.
shots.action: Bruno lowers his nose beside the tortoise toy.
shots.mood: Warm sunlight, bright flowers, Bruno's wide curious eyes.

shots.narration: Its little wooden feet move very, very slowly.
shots.scene: Close view of the garden path edge, worn green tortoise toy with rounded wooden feet and a winding key.
shots.action: The wind-up tortoise toy inches onto the path.
shots.mood: Soft golden light, Bruno watching with an eager smile.

shots.narration: [chuckles] Bruno's paws are ready, but this journey needs patience.
shots.scene: Garden path beside the slowly moving wooden tortoise toy, colourful flowerbeds behind.
shots.action: Bruno takes one exaggerated tiny step beside the toy.
shots.mood: Playful floppy ears, raised paw, cheerful sunshine.

shots.narration: Then a pebble stops the tortoise's tiny feet.
shots.scene: Middle of the garden path, a small smooth pebble directly ahead of the wooden tortoise toy.
shots.action: The tortoise toy bumps gently against the pebble.
shots.mood: Small harmless obstacle, Bruno's puzzled head tilt, warm light.

shots.narration: Bruno nudges, but the little feet still cannot climb.
shots.scene: Close view of the toy resting against the rounded pebble on the sunny path.
shots.action: Bruno gently nudges the back of the tortoise toy.
shots.mood: Tender concentration, relaxed floppy ears, soft garden colours.

shots.narration: [whispers] Mishi spots a smoother way around.
shots.scene: Garden path with the blocked toy, a clear strip of smooth paving beside the pebble, Mishi near Bruno.
shots.action: Mishi points one paw toward the clear paving.
shots.mood: Mishi's bright green eyes, Bruno's attentive face, sunny reassuring colours.

shots.narration: Bruno carefully turns the tortoise toward Mishi's clear route.
shots.scene: Sunny path with the small pebble and a clear route around it.
shots.action: Bruno gently rotates the tortoise toy away from the pebble.
shots.mood: Careful paws, Mishi's approving smile, soft warm light.

shots.narration: Together, they follow at the tortoise's own little pace.
shots.scene: Smooth section of garden path, the wooden tortoise toy ahead of the two friends.
shots.action: Mishi and Bruno take a tiny step behind the moving toy.
shots.mood: Matching patient smiles, gently curved tails, colourful flowers.

shots.narration: [excited] Just one more tiny step to the other side!
shots.scene: Far edge of the garden path, tortoise toy a short distance from the grass, friends watching behind.
shots.action: The tortoise toy advances its final little step.
shots.mood: Bright hopeful eyes, sunlit grass, a small triumphant moment.

shots.narration: Made it! Bruno gives their slow little traveller a bow.
shots.scene: Tortoise toy safely resting on the grassy far side of the path, Mishi beside Bruno.
shots.action: Bruno bows toward the tortoise toy.
shots.mood: Mishi's delighted smile, Bruno's silly proud pose, golden sunshine.

shots.narration: But what's this ribbon hiding beside the flowers?
shots.scene: Grassy path edge beside the parked tortoise toy, a yellow ribbon trailing behind a flowerpot.
shots.action: Mishi lifts the loose end of the ribbon.
shots.mood: Curious green eyes, Bruno's perked expression, cosy garden colours.

shots.narration: [giggles] Helping takes patience; next, where does this ribbon lead?
shots.scene: Sunny garden with a yellow ribbon winding behind rounded flowerpots, tortoise toy resting beside the path.
shots.action: Mishi and Bruno peer behind the nearest flowerpot.
shots.mood: Friendly anticipation, bright flowers, warm soft lighting.

episode.endHook: Where does the ribbon in the garden lead?
episode.description: Bruno helps an old wind-up tortoise toy cross the garden path, but a tiny bump stops its journey. With Mishi’s careful thinking, the friends discover that helping takes patience.
